cards.name: Maximum Six
cards.officialText: When this card is Tribute Summoned: Roll a six-sided die, and this card gains ATK equal to the result x 200.

cards.name: Graceful Dice
cards.officialText: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters you currently control gain ATK/DEF equal to the result x 100, until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Skull Dice
cards.officialText: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK/DEF equal to the result x 100, until the end of this turn.

supports: team-controlled monsters gain ATK/DEF until End Phase
opponent-controlled monsters lose ATK/DEF until End Phase

behavior: All three effects consume one result from the persisted HMAC-SHA256 duel random stream; no Math.random fallback.
Graceful Dice applies +roll×100 ATK/DEF to face-up monsters controlled by the activating team at resolution, including its inactive partner.
Skull Dice applies -roll×100 ATK/DEF to face-up monsters controlled by the opposing team at resolution, including that team's inactive partner.
Graceful Dice from hand requires the active physical owner's own turn; Quick-Play/Trap cards Set in a previous turn may be activated by the active seat of their team when it has priority.
Graceful Dice and Skull Dice may respond in the Damage Step before Damage Calculation because they modify ATK/DEF; they cannot be activated during Damage Calculation or chained to a Counter Trap.
Maximum Six triggers only after a successful Tribute Summon; its +roll×200 ATK modifier lasts while that same physical card remains face-up on the field and is removed on face-down/leave/re-entry.
Negated activations do not roll or apply modifiers; duplicate resolution is idempotent.
No automatic discard: a seven-card hand remains intact until the End Phase.
limitations: Adapter isolado: não registra as três cartas em effectRegistry nem altera o resolver central, catálogo, certificações, allowlist, comandos ou banco.
Os testes usam IDs físicos já certificados como fixtures e injetam a identidade mecânica por lookup; os três passcodes reais continuam ausentes do catálogo.
O adapter modela o resultado após a cadeia ser confirmada pelo host; a integração central deve fornecer a janela/negação e persistir sessão+RNG atomicamente.
O adapter não valida um gateway Discord/guild real; não há merge, deploy ou backup de produção.
